# Microsoft To Do

Microsoft To Do is a cloud-based task management application that lets users create, organize, and track task lists, tasks, checklist items, and reminders across devices via Microsoft Graph

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/microsoft-todo/.

## Actions

- **Complete Task**: Mark a Microsoft To Do task as completed.
- **Create Checklist Item**: Add a checklist item (subtask) to a Microsoft To Do task.
- **Create Task**: Create a task in a Microsoft To Do task list.
- **Create Task List**: Create a new Microsoft To Do task list.
- **Delete Checklist Item**: Delete a checklist item (subtask) from a Microsoft To Do task.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a task from a Microsoft To Do task list.
- **Delete Task Attachment**: Permanently delete a file attachment from a Microsoft To Do task.
- **Delete Task List**: Delete a Microsoft To Do task list.
- **Download Task Attachment** (read-only): Download one file attached to a Microsoft To Do task.
- **Get Checklist Item** (read-only): Get a single Microsoft To Do checklist item (subtask) by its id, within a task in a task list.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the profile of the Microsoft account connected to this toolkit (whoami / connection verification).
- **Get Task** (read-only): Get a single Microsoft To Do task by its id, within a task list.
- **Get Task Attachment** (read-only): Get metadata for one file attached to a Microsoft To Do task.
- **Get Task List** (read-only): Get a single Microsoft To Do task list by its id.
- **List Checklist Items** (read-only): List the checklist items (subtasks) of a To Do task.
- **List Task Attachments** (read-only): List the files attached to a Microsoft To Do task.
- **List Task Lists** (read-only): List the To Do task lists owned by the connected user.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): List the tasks in a To Do task list.
- **Update Checklist Item**: Update a checklist item (subtask) of a Microsoft To Do task.
- **Update Task**: Update fields of an existing Microsoft To Do task (title, notes, importance, status, due/start/reminder dates, categories).
- **Update Task List**: Rename a Microsoft To Do task list (updates its displayName).
- **Upload Task Attachment**: Attach a file up to 25 MB to a Microsoft To Do task.
